name: code-report

_source.note: Copied by vkit sync-reference; edit the reference, not this file.

_keys.ink: text and stroke colour on that ground
_keys.paper: the surface of a card, clipping or slide when it differs from the ground
_keys.accents: at most three, in priority order; the checker sums their share
_keys.type: family class, weight, case and the sizes used for title, label and body
_keys.strokes: width in px, seeded roughness 0 to 1, glow in px, cap style
_keys.entrance: how an element arrives: kind, duration ms, easing, distance px or scale from
_keys.camera: static, push, or drift; percent of frame height per second; scale change over a hold
_keys.cutSeconds: seconds between shots, full and formal
_keys.holdSeconds: longest still without a build or a moving camera, full and formal
_keys.textOnFrame: what kinds of text appear: none, labels, bullets, titles, code, captions
_keys.evidence: what shows a fact: recreated screens, documents, icons, figures
_keys.sceneKinds: the rig's scene kinds this look serves best
_keys.pacing: words per minute: creator measured, our target; sentence average words
_keys.voice: the register the narration takes in this look, in a phrase

evidence: screenshots with ids, rotated 2 degrees with a shadow
voice: first person, present tense, dry, a verdict with numbers
